purpose: Identify an action as essential to a meaningful result.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Only by actually using it can you appreciate its convenience.
Only by discussing it with each other can we resolve the misunderstanding.
It is only when we are healthy that we can enjoy traveling.
restrictions: The action is a necessary foundation for the result’s value or realization.
mistake: It is stronger than a simple chronological “after”.
